text: Time model: walk 1 s per cell, 5 s per pick; plan totals come from the same walk the simulator streams; reason: one source of truth for KPIs; override: change constants in routeopt

Savings benchmark is aggregate over 200 seeded maps with shuffled customer order; per-basket figures printed not asserted; reason: the 30% claim is about the aggregate; override: edit tests/test_savings.py with human approval
Maps are JSON grids: shelves are non-walkable cells, products picked from adjacent aisle cells; reason: matches the MAP input described; override: new input format
missing, empty, malformed, wrong-type, unknown-id inputs on compare and simulate; one message, non-zero exit
duplicate ids and two products on one shelf cell are both counted
unrequested broken product does not block; requested unreachable product fails with its id
distance and time recomputed from cells and picks with separate code, incl. duplicate-id input
refusals (isolated product, isolated checkout) confirmed by a separate BFS; servable products never refused
1500 purely random maps, random baskets with unknown ids and bad shelves (tests/test_fuzz.py): 258 served, 1242 refused, all match a separate BFS oracle; no failure
Attacks written and run by the same agent, not a fresh-context subagent: all five attack classes ran on first build with no failure
30% holds only in aggregate over 200 generated baskets (45.4%); per-basket saving ranges 1.9% to 72.0%, median 44.0%; baskets already in good order save little

Time is modelled (1 s per cell, 5 s per pick), not measured on people; real-time means one step per print, but the order is computed before the first step (about 6.5 s on a 300x300 store with 40 items)

Optimized route is the shorter of the solver order and the list order, by walked time; reason: optimized never worse than list order; override: use solver order alone in routeopt/core.py _choose_order
Refusal attack was logged after the first verify, so the herd check warning remains
none: C1 check reverted to its original command after being widened; the fuzz test moved to agent-proposed C6
